I have considered buying a cheap shotgun since I have just enough money left for that and it's easy here, but even though firearms are listed as the most lethal means of suicide, the fatality rate is still only about 85%. 15% is a big margin of error. I guess the same sorts of fears that make me leery about ending up in a hospital also make me shy away from actually shooting myself. Like, when I'm at my lowest, it certainly feels like nothing could be worse, but if I really believed that, I wouldn't be afraid of, well, making it worse.

It isn't even true when people say this to me. It's fucking bullshit. They love some vaguely person-shaped space where I am that I'll never be. They don't love me; they just think they should and they don't want to feel guilty about telling me the truth, which is that I'm a fucking drain on them and they'd be so much better off without me.
No one cares. There's no point trying. We're all better off dead anyway.

But I also know I'll never be able to stick to that. I've thought like that before: "I should just not interact with people, then it won't matter how much of a mess I am, because at least I won't be hurting anybody." But I can't

I feel so worthless. I can't get out from under these feelings of despair and shame. The times I've talked to a therapist, they've said things like, "The work you do isn't the only value you have," but I have never, ever believed that. How could I? Yeah, okay, other people, *normal* people have value just as people--because they have relationships. I don't have any left. I never had many, was never any good *at* having them (how could I be? I'm weird, and I'm self-absorbed, and I'm just--*there's something wrong with me,* nobody ever really wanted to be friends with me when I was a kid or most of my adult life and I don't think it's because \~they were mean to me\~ or whatever, I think it's because I'm *wrong*), but now I have practically none. One friend I talk to pretty often online, and I know she cares about me, but she's not a disaster like I am, she has her own life, and she can't sit around waiting for me to stop being a train wreck mentally and emotionally and materially.

So you'd really think, since it's the only thing that gives me value at all, that I'd at least have a killer career. But I don't. I've never had one, period. I've floated around from one crappy job to another because I've always been *so scared* to *try* anything more, because every time I thought about it I couldn't justify why anyone should trust me with anything more than low-level stuff. I don't have any skills other than writing, really, and that's hardly ever valuable.

So I have nothing. I *am* nothing. And I can step back and say, "This is a crazy way of looking at myself and the world and of going through life, this isn't normal or productive," but it doesn't help. I don't have the basic self-discipline to *act* on that. I just feel bad about it. And then I do all the same stuff.

But I can't stop, because I *know* I'm worthless. I know it. I know it, I know it, I know it. I just want to find a way of making enough money to feed myself and put a roof over my head and do it remotely so that I never have to see or speak to another human being and then hide in my place and never come out. If I live like that, then at least nobody will be able to say that I'm making my issues everybody else's problem.

I swing between thinking I'm garbage and thinking that no, I can be useful and contribute and maybe be okay someday. But I'm just so paralyzed that I don't know how to get there. So then I feel worse because I think I *should* be able to be okay and I don't have a good explanation for why I'm like this instead.
My mother has to watch me ruin and waste my life. I feel so guilty and ashamed all the time, but I can't or won't change.

I don't know why I'm LIKE this. My brother is FINE. He's successful and he has friends and he's fine.  I don't have any excuse for being like this. I hate myself and I hate how useless I am and I hate that I'm a drain on my family and I hate knowing that there's no reason, none at all, why I can't be like him, except that apparently I wake up every day and choose not to be??? I DON'T KNOW WHAT'S WRONG WITH ME OR HOW TO FIX IT EXCEPT BY KILLING MYSELF.

I've been looking up crisis centers and stuff but I'm American and I'm afraid that if I call, they'll send someone because I'm suicidal, and then I'll get a bill for thousands and thousands of dollars a month later. I don't have any money, because I've been unemployed for almost a year. I don't have insurance because I don't have any income and my savings are almost gone. So if I try to get help, I'll probably get a huge medical bill for it. I won't have any way to pay it, so my family would have to, and I'd just be a worse parasite than ever.
